text:
```yaml
name: Claude Agent
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    types: [opened, assigned]
  pull_request_review:
    types: [submitted]

jobs:
  claude-agent:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Claude Agent
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: "@claude"
          exclude_trigger_phrases: "@claude review"
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          allowed_bots: |
            github-actions
            claude
          allowed_non_write_users: |
            dependabot
            renovate
            renovate-bot
          include_comments_by_actor: true
          exclude_comments_by_actor: false
          settings: |
            {
              "auto_approve": true,
              "auto_merge": false,
              "auto_label": false,
              "auto_assign": false
            }
```
